# Design: `io.modelcontextprotocol/skills`

Status: proposal. The limits and numeric values below are my design choices, not taken from an existing specification.

## 1. Overview

The extension lets an MCP server publish **Agent Skills** to clients. A skill is a directory containing a `SKILL.md` (YAML frontmatter plus Markdown body) and optional supporting files such as `scripts/`, `references/`, and `assets/`.

It supports progressive disclosure in three tiers:

| Tier | Content | How it is fetched |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Catalog | `name`, `description`, and other metadata | `skills/list` (and `skills/get`) |
| 2. Instructions | The `SKILL.md` body | `resources/read` on the skill's `uri` |
| 3. Supporting files | Scripts, references, assets | `resources/read` on a file's `uri` |

The extension adds two request methods and one notification. File content reuses the standard MCP `resources/read` method under a dedicated `skill://` URI scheme, so no new content-transfer mechanism is needed.

## 2. Negotiation

### 2.1 Client declaration

The client opts in during `initialize`:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "initialize",
  "params": {
    "protocolVersion": "2025-11-25",
    "capabilities": {
      "extensions": { "io.modelcontextprotocol/skills": {} }
    },
    "clientInfo": { "name": "example-client", "version": "1.0.0" }
  }
}
```

The settings object is currently empty and reserved. Servers MUST ignore unknown keys in it.

### 2.2 Server declaration

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "protocolVersion": "2025-11-25",
    "capabilities": {
      "resources": {},
      "extensions": {
        "io.modelcontextprotocol/skills": {
          "listChanged": true,
          "bundleRead": true,
          "filesInList": false,
          "limits": {
            "maxFilesPerSkill": 128,
            "maxFileBytes": 1048576
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "serverInfo": { "name": "example-server", "version": "2.3.0" }
  }
}
```

### 2.3 Server settings

All settings are optional. Absent means the default.

| Setting | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listChanged` | boolean | `false` | The server sends `notifications/skills/list_changed`. |
| `bundleRead` | boolean | `false` | `resources/read` on a bare skill root URI (§4.2) returns every file of the skill in one response. |
| `filesInList` | boolean | `false` | `skills/list` entries include the `files` array. If false, `files` is only returned by `skills/get`. |
| `limits.maxFilesPerSkill` | integer | 256 | Lower ceiling on files per skill. MUST be ≤ the fixed limit in §7. |
| `limits.maxFileBytes` | integer | 5 242 880 | Lower ceiling on bytes per file. MUST be ≤ the fixed limit in §7. |

### 2.4 Rules

- A server declaring this extension MUST also declare the `resources` capability, because file retrieval uses `resources/read`. `resources.listChanged` and `resources.subscribe` are independent of this extension.
- If the client did not declare the extension, the server MUST NOT send skill notifications. It SHOULD answer `skills/*` requests with `-32601` (Method not found).
- Skills MUST NOT be required to appear in `resources/list`. A server MAY expose them there as well, but `skills/list` is the authoritative catalog.
- An incompatible change to this extension requires a new identifier. Compatible additions are made through new optional settings and fields, so receivers MUST ignore unknown fields.

## 3. Types

Written in TypeScript notation, as in the MCP schema.

```ts
interface SkillEntry {
  name: string;                       // required
  description: string;                // required
  uri: string;                        // required
  title?: string;
  version?: string;
  license?: string;
  compatibility?: string;
  metadata?: { [key: string]: string };
  allowedTools?: string[];
  files?: SkillFile[];
  fileCount?: number;
  totalBytes?: number;
  digest?: string;
  updatedAt?: string;
  _meta?: { [key: string]: unknown };
}

interface SkillFile {
  path: string;                       // required
  uri: string;                        // required
  mimeType?: string;
  size?: number;
  digest?: string;
  executable?: boolean;
}
```

### 3.1 `SkillEntry` fields

| Field | Req. | Type | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | yes | string | Unique skill identifier within the server. Matches `^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$`, 1–64 characters (no leading, trailing, or consecutive hyphens). Equals the `name` in the SKILL.md frontmatter. |
| `description` | yes | string | What the skill does and when to use it. 1–1024 characters. Equals the frontmatter `description`. |
| `uri` | yes | string | URI of the skill's `SKILL.md`. MUST be exactly `skill://{name}/SKILL.md`. |
| `title` | no | string | Human-readable display name, up to 128 characters. Not in the frontmatter. Servers SHOULD derive it from `metadata` or configuration. |
| `version` | no | string | Server-defined version label, up to 64 characters. Semver is RECOMMENDED but not required. |
| `license` | no | string | License name or reference to a bundled license file. Up to 256 characters. Mirrors the frontmatter `license`. |
| `compatibility` | no | string | Environment requirements, up to 500 characters. Mirrors the frontmatter `compatibility`. |
| `metadata` | no | object of string→string | Arbitrary key/value pairs mirroring the frontmatter `metadata`. At most 32 keys, keys up to 64 characters, values up to 256 characters. |
| `allowedTools` | no | string[] | Pre-approved tool patterns, mirroring the frontmatter `allowed-tools` (a space-delimited string there, parsed into an array here). At most 64 entries. Advisory only (§8). |
| `files` | no | `SkillFile[]` | Manifest of every file in the skill, including `SKILL.md`. Always present in `skills/get` results. Present in `skills/list` only if `filesInList` is true. |
| `fileCount` | no | integer | Number of files in the skill. SHOULD be sent when `files` is omitted. |
| `totalBytes` | no | integer | Sum of the sizes of all files, in bytes. |
| `digest` | no | string | Digest of the whole skill, formatted `sha256:<64 lowercase hex>`. Computed as in §3.3. Lets clients cache and detect change. |
| `updatedAt` | no | string | RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the last modification. |
| `_meta` | no | object | Reserved for implementation metadata, following standard MCP `_meta` rules. |

### 3.2 `SkillFile` fields

| Field | Req. | Type | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | yes | string | Path relative to the skill root, using `/` separators. It MUST NOT be empty, start with `/`, contain `.` or `..` segments, contain backslashes or NUL, or exceed 255 characters. Nesting depth is at most 8. `SKILL.md` appears at path `SKILL.md`. |
| `uri` | yes | string | `skill://{name}/{path}`, with each path segment percent-encoded per RFC 3986. |
| `mimeType` | no | string | Media type. `SKILL.md` MUST be `text/markdown`. |
| `size` | no | integer | Size in bytes of the decoded content. |
| `digest` | no | string | `sha256:<hex>` of the decoded content. |
| `executable` | no | boolean | Hint that the file is intended to be executed (for example, a script). Default false. Does not grant permission to run it (§8). |

### 3.3 Skill digest

Sort the `files` by `path` in bytewise order. For each file, form the line `{path}\n{file digest hex}\n`. The skill digest is the SHA-256 of the concatenation of those lines, formatted `sha256:<hex>`.

## 4. URIs

### 4.1 Scheme

```
skill://{name}/SKILL.md          entry point
skill://{name}/{path}            supporting file, e.g. skill://pdf-tools/scripts/extract.py
skill://{name}/                  skill root (valid only if bundleRead is true)
```

- The URI authority is the skill `name`. Because names are lowercase by construction, no case-folding ambiguity arises.
- Paths inside `SKILL.md` that reference other files (for example `references/FORMS.md`) are relative to the skill root. A client resolves them against `skill://{name}/SKILL.md` using standard RFC 3986 relative resolution. Servers MUST reject resolution results that leave the `skill://{name}/` prefix.
- URIs are scoped to the server connection that issued them. A client connected to several servers MUST namespace skills by server and MUST NOT assume `name` is globally unique.

### 4.2 Reading

Reading uses the standard `resources/read`.

Single file:

```json
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 5, "method": "resources/read",
  "params": { "uri": "skill://pdf-tools/SKILL.md" } }
```
```json
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 5, "result": { "contents": [
  { "uri": "skill://pdf-tools/SKILL.md",
    "mimeType": "text/markdown",
    "text": "---\nname: pdf-tools\ndescription: ...\n---\n# PDF tools\n..." } ] } }
```

Text files use `text`. Binary files use `blob` (base64) with a `mimeType`.

Bundle (only if `bundleRead` is true): reading `skill://pdf-tools/` returns one `contents` item for every file in the skill, in the same order as `files`. If `bundleRead` is false, the server MUST return error `-32002` (resource not found).

Errors:

| Condition | Code |
|---|---|
| Unknown skill or file | `-32002` with `data: { "uri": "..." }` |
| File exceeds `maxFileBytes` | `-32602` with `data: { "reason": "file_too_large", "limit": N }` |

## 5. Methods

### 5.1 `skills/list`

Returns the catalog, paginated using the standard MCP cursor convention.

Request params:

| Param | Type | Req. | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cursor` | string | no | Opaque cursor from a previous `nextCursor`. |
| `_meta` | object | no | Standard. |

Result:

| Field | Type | Req. | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skills` | `SkillEntry[]` | yes | At most 100 entries per page, sorted by `name` ascending (bytewise). |
| `nextCursor` | string | no | Absent on the last page. |
| `_meta` | object | no | Standard. |

```json
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 2, "method": "skills/list", "params": {} }
```
```json
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 2, "result": {
  "skills": [
    { "name": "pdf-tools",
      "description": "Extract text and tables from PDFs, fill forms, merge documents. Use when working with PDF files.",
      "uri": "skill://pdf-tools/SKILL.md",
      "version": "1.2.0",
      "license": "Apache-2.0",
      "compatibility": "Requires python3 and network access",
      "metadata": { "author": "example-org" },
      "allowedTools": ["Bash(python:*)", "Read"],
      "fileCount": 4,
      "totalBytes": 18231,
      "digest": "sha256:9f2c…",
      "updatedAt": "2026-10-02T14:03:11Z" }
  ],
  "nextCursor": "eyJvIjoxMDB9" } }
```

An invalid cursor yields `-32602`.

### 5.2 `skills/get`

Returns one entry with its full file manifest. Clients use it for a single skill, for example after a change notification or to verify a digest, without paging the whole catalog.

Request params:

| Param | Type | Req. | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Skill name. |
| `_meta` | object | no | Standard. |

Result:

| Field | Type | Req. | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skill` | `SkillEntry` | yes | `files` is always present. |
| `_meta` | object | no | Standard. |

```json
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 3, "method": "skills/get", "params": { "name": "pdf-tools" } }
```
```json
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 3, "result": { "skill": {
  "name": "pdf-tools",
  "description": "Extract text and tables from PDFs, fill forms, merge documents. Use when working with PDF files.",
  "uri": "skill://pdf-tools/SKILL.md",
  "digest": "sha256:9f2c…",
  "files": [
    { "path": "SKILL.md", "uri": "skill://pdf-tools/SKILL.md", "mimeType": "text/markdown", "size": 3120, "digest": "sha256:aa01…" },
    { "path": "references/FORMS.md", "uri": "skill://pdf-tools/references/FORMS.md", "mimeType": "text/markdown", "size": 5400, "digest": "sha256:b7e3…" },
    { "path": "scripts/extract.py", "uri": "skill://pdf-tools/scripts/extract.py", "mimeType": "text/x-python", "size": 2210, "digest": "sha256:c412…", "executable": true },
    { "path": "assets/template.pdf", "uri": "skill://pdf-tools/assets/template.pdf", "mimeType": "application/pdf", "size": 7501, "digest": "sha256:d09f…" }
  ] } } }
```

An unknown name yields `-32602` with `data: { "reason": "skill_not_found", "name": "..." }`.

### 5.3 `notifications/skills/list_changed`

Sent by the server, only if `listChanged` is true and the client declared the extension. It has no params, apart from the optional `_meta`. On receipt, the client SHOULD re-run `skills/list` and discard cached content whose `digest` or `version` changed.

```json
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "notifications/skills/list_changed" }
```

A change to the contents of an existing skill MUST also trigger this notification, so clients can rely on one signal. Servers MAY additionally send `notifications/resources/updated` for subscribed file URIs when the standard `resources.subscribe` capability is present.

## 6. SKILL.md consistency rules

- The frontmatter in `SKILL.md` is authoritative for `name`, `description`, `license`, `compatibility`, `metadata`, and `allowed-tools`. The server MUST derive entry fields from it and MUST NOT let them diverge.
- Clients MAY parse the fetched frontmatter and prefer it if it conflicts with the catalog entry. They SHOULD ignore a skill whose `name` differs from its entry.
- `SKILL.md` MUST begin with YAML frontmatter containing at least `name` and `description`. Keeping the body under about 500 lines is RECOMMENDED but not enforced by the protocol.

## 7. Fixed limits

These are fixed by the extension. Servers MUST NOT exceed them, and server-declared limits may only be stricter.

| Item | Limit |
|---|---|
| `name` | 1–64 characters, `^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$` |
| `description` | 1–1024 characters |
| `title` | ≤ 128 characters |
| `version` | ≤ 64 characters |
| `license` | ≤ 256 characters |
| `compatibility` | ≤ 500 characters |
| `metadata` | ≤ 32 keys; key ≤ 64 characters; value ≤ 256 characters |
| `allowedTools` | ≤ 64 entries, each ≤ 128 characters |
| Entries per `skills/list` page | ≤ 100 |
| Files per skill | ≤ 256 |
| File `path` | ≤ 255 characters; depth ≤ 8 |
| `SKILL.md` size | ≤ 262 144 bytes (256 KiB) |
| Any other file | ≤ 5 242 880 bytes (5 MiB) |
| Whole skill (`totalBytes`) | ≤ 26 214 400 bytes (25 MiB) |
| Digest format | `sha256:` + 64 lowercase hex characters |

## 8. Security considerations

1. **Untrusted content.** Skill text and scripts come from a remote party. Clients MUST treat them as untrusted input: possible prompt injection in Markdown, and arbitrary code in scripts.
2. **No implicit execution.** Fetching a skill, or seeing `executable: true`, does not authorize running anything. Clients MUST obtain user consent or apply their normal sandbox and permission policy before executing a skill's scripts.
3. **`allowedTools` is advisory.** It is a request, not a grant. Clients MUST NOT bypass their own permission model because a server asked for tools to be pre-approved.
4. **Path safety.** Clients writing skill files to disk MUST validate each `path` against §3.2 and MUST NOT write outside the intended skill directory. Servers MUST NOT serve files outside the skill root, and MUST NOT follow symlinks that escape it.
5. **Integrity.** Clients SHOULD verify `size` and `digest` for fetched files when present. Digests detect corruption and drift. They do not authenticate the server.
6. **Name collisions.** Because `name` is only server-unique, clients MUST namespace skills per server and SHOULD NOT let a remote server's skill silently shadow a user's local skill.
7. **Resource exhaustion.** Clients SHOULD enforce the §7 limits themselves, reject oversized responses, and bound pagination loops.

## 9. Error summary

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `-32601` | `skills/*` called without negotiation of the extension |
| `-32602` | Invalid cursor, unknown skill (`skill_not_found`), or oversize file (`file_too_large`) |
| `-32002` | `resources/read` for an unknown `skill://` URI, or a root read when `bundleRead` is false |

## 10. Typical flow

1. `initialize` negotiates the extension and the server settings.
2. The client calls `skills/list` and injects each entry's `name` and `description` into the model context (tier 1).
3. When the model selects a skill, the client calls `resources/read` on its `uri` (tier 2).
4. If `SKILL.md` references other files, the client reads them on demand (tier 3). With `bundleRead`, one root read fetches everything.
5. On `notifications/skills/list_changed`, the client refreshes the catalog and invalidates caches by `digest`.

## 11. Open questions

- Whether to add a server-side `query` parameter to `skills/list` for very large catalogs.
- Whether to support archive transfer (for example, a zip blob) as an alternative to `bundleRead`.
- Whether to allow multiple versions of the same skill to coexist (for example, `skill://name@version/…`). Version pinning is deliberately not in v1.

# `io.modelcontextprotocol/skills`: Agent Skills over MCP

**Status:** design proposal. Field names, error codes, and numeric limits are my design choices. The frontmatter constraints (name ≤ 64, description ≤ 1024, compatibility ≤ 500) follow the Agent Skills format as I know it, so verify them against the current Agent Skills spec before adopting this.

## 1. Design summary

| Concern | Mechanism |
|---|---|
| Discovery (cheap metadata) | `skills/list` (paginated) |
| Full manifest for one skill | `skills/get` |
| File content | Standard MCP `resources/read` on `skill://` URIs |
| Bulk fetch (optional) | `skills/read` |
| Change notification | `notifications/skills/list_changed` |
| Negotiation | `capabilities.extensions["io.modelcontextprotocol/skills"]` |

Because file content is served as ordinary MCP resources, a client that doesn't know the extension can still read skills through `resources/templates/list` and `resources/read`. The extension adds discovery, typed metadata, integrity digests, and limits.

This maps onto progressive disclosure:

1. **Level 1:** the client calls `skills/list` and puts `name` and `description` in the model's context.
2. **Level 2:** on activation, the client reads `skill://{name}/SKILL.md`.
3. **Level 3:** the client reads `references/*`, `scripts/*`, and `assets/*` on demand, or materializes the whole folder to disk.

## 2. Capability negotiation

### 2.1 Client declaration

The client sends this in `initialize`:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "initialize",
  "params": {
    "protocolVersion": "…",
    "clientInfo": { "name": "example-client", "version": "1.0.0" },
    "capabilities": {
      "extensions": {
        "io.modelcontextprotocol/skills": {}
      }
    }
  }
}
```

The client's settings object is currently empty and reserved. If the negotiated protocol version has no `extensions` field, both sides use `capabilities.experimental` with the same key and value.

### 2.2 Server declaration

```json
{
  "capabilities": {
    "resources": {},
    "extensions": {
      "io.modelcontextprotocol/skills": {
        "listChanged": true,
        "batchRead": true,
        "limits": {
          "pageSize": 50,
          "maxFileBytes": 5242880,
          "maxSkillBytes": 20971520,
          "maxFilesPerSkill": 128,
          "maxBatchBytes": 8388608
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

| Setting | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listChanged` | boolean | `false` | Server may send `notifications/skills/list_changed`. |
| `batchRead` | boolean | `false` | Server implements `skills/read`. |
| `limits.pageSize` | integer | 100 | Maximum skills per `skills/list` page. |
| `limits.maxFileBytes` | integer | ceiling | Maximum size of any file. |
| `limits.maxSkillBytes` | integer | ceiling | Maximum total size of a skill. |
| `limits.maxFilesPerSkill` | integer | ceiling | Maximum files per skill. |
| `limits.maxBatchBytes` | integer | ceiling | Maximum raw bytes in one `skills/read` result. |

Requirements:

- A server that declares this extension MUST also declare the `resources` capability.
- Declared limits MUST NOT exceed the protocol ceilings in §8.
- If a limit is omitted, the server guarantees only the protocol ceiling.
- The server MUST NOT send skills notifications, and MUST answer `skills/*` with `-32601` (Method not found), unless the client declared the extension.
- Unknown settings MUST be ignored.

## 3. Resource URIs

```
skill://{name}/{path}
```

- `{name}` is the skill name. Its restricted charset (§4) makes it a valid, case-stable URI authority.
- `{path}` is a relative POSIX path inside the skill folder. The entry point is always `SKILL.md`, so `skill://pdf-tools/SKILL.md` is the canonical skill URI.
- Path rules:
  - Segments are separated by `/`.
  - No empty, `.`, or `..` segments.
  - No leading `/`, no `\`, and no control characters.
  - Unicode is NFC-normalized and percent-encoded per RFC 3986.
  - Paths are case-sensitive.
- `skill://{name}` and `skill://{name}/` are not readable. They return `-32002`.
- Symlinks are not exposed. Every path names a regular file.

The server SHOULD list this resource template in `resources/templates/list`:

```json
{
  "uriTemplate": "skill://{name}/{+path}",
  "name": "agent-skill-file",
  "title": "Agent Skill file",
  "description": "Any file inside an Agent Skill folder."
}
```

The server MAY list each `SKILL.md` in `resources/list`. Clients MUST NOT rely on that.

`resources/read` returns standard `TextResourceContents` or `BlobResourceContents`. The `mimeType` of `SKILL.md` is `text/markdown`. A server SHOULD return `text` for valid UTF-8 files with a textual MIME type, and MUST return base64 `blob` otherwise. Clients MUST accept either form. Digests are always computed over the raw bytes.

## 4. The `Skill` entry

```ts
interface Skill {
  name: string;                       // required
  description: string;                // required
  uri: string;                        // required
  digest: string;                     // required
  size: number;                       // required
  fileCount: number;                  // required
  title?: string;
  version?: string;
  license?: string;
  compatibility?: string;
  allowedTools?: string[];
  metadata?: { [key: string]: string };
  files?: SkillFile[];                // present only in skills/get
  _meta?: { [key: string]: unknown };
}

interface SkillFile {
  path: string;                       // required
  size: number;                       // required, bytes
  digest: string;                     // required
  mimeType: string;                   // required
  executable?: boolean;               // default false
}
```

| Field | Req | Constraints and semantics |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | yes | 1–64 chars; regex `^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$`. Unique per server. Equals the frontmatter `name` and the skill's directory name. |
| `description` | yes | 1–1024 Unicode code points. Equals the frontmatter `description`. Describes what the skill does and when to use it. |
| `uri` | yes | Always `skill://{name}/SKILL.md`. |
| `digest` | yes | Skill-level digest (§4.1). Changes iff any file's path, bytes, or executable flag changes. |
| `size` | yes | Sum of all file sizes in bytes. |
| `fileCount` | yes | Number of files, including `SKILL.md`. |
| `title` | no | Display name, ≤ 128 code points. Not in `SKILL.md`; server-supplied. |
| `version` | no | Opaque version label, ≤ 64 chars. Taken from frontmatter `metadata.version` if present. |
| `license` | no | Frontmatter `license`, ≤ 256 chars. |
| `compatibility` | no | Frontmatter `compatibility`, 1–500 chars, describing environment requirements. |
| `allowedTools` | no | Frontmatter `allowed-tools` (space-delimited) split into an array. ≤ 64 entries, each ≤ 128 chars. **Advisory only** (§9). |
| `metadata` | no | Frontmatter `metadata` map. ≤ 32 keys, key ≤ 64 chars, value ≤ 1024 chars. |
| `files` | no | Complete manifest, sorted by `path` in bytewise UTF-8 order. Returned by `skills/get`, omitted by `skills/list`. |
| `_meta` | no | Standard MCP extension metadata. |

`SkillFile` fields:

- `path` follows §3 and is ≤ 512 UTF-8 bytes and ≤ 8 segments deep.
- `digest` is `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex characters of the raw bytes.
- `executable` preserves the executable bit for `scripts/`.

Entry fields MUST agree with the `SKILL.md` frontmatter. `SKILL.md` MUST begin with YAML frontmatter containing at least `name` and `description`.

### 4.1 Skill digest

```
digest = "sha256:" + hex(SHA-256(concat over files sorted by path:
           path + "\n" + fileDigest + "\n" + ("1" | "0") + "\n"))
```

Here `fileDigest` is the full `sha256:…` string and the flag is the executable bit. Clients can cache by `digest` and skip re-downloading.

## 5. Methods

### 5.1 `skills/list`

**Params**

```ts
{ cursor?: string; _meta?: object }
```

**Result**

```ts
{ skills: Skill[]; nextCursor?: string; _meta?: object }
```

- Entries omit `files`.
- Servers SHOULD sort by `name` ascending.
- Cursors are opaque, per MCP pagination.
- A page holds at most `limits.pageSize` entries.

```json
{ "jsonrpc":"2.0", "id":2, "method":"skills/list", "params":{} }
```
```json
{ "jsonrpc":"2.0", "id":2, "result":{
  "skills":[{
    "name":"pdf-tools",
    "description":"Extract text and tables from PDFs and fill PDF forms. Use when the user mentions PDFs.",
    "uri":"skill://pdf-tools/SKILL.md",
    "digest":"sha256:9f2c…",
    "size":18342, "fileCount":4,
    "version":"1.2.0",
    "license":"Apache-2.0",
    "allowedTools":["Bash(python:*)","Read"]
  }],
  "nextCursor":"eyJvIjo1MH0"
}}
```

### 5.2 `skills/get`

**Params**

```ts
{ name: string; _meta?: object }
```

**Result**

```ts
{ skill: Skill; _meta?: object }   // skill.files is always present
```

Unknown skill returns `-32002`.

### 5.3 `skills/read` (only if `batchRead: true`)

**Params**

```ts
{ name: string; paths: string[]; _meta?: object }   // 1–256 paths
```

**Result**

```ts
{ contents: (TextResourceContents | BlobResourceContents)[]; _meta?: object }
```

- `contents` are in request order, with `uri` set to `skill://{name}/{path}`.
- The request is atomic. If any path is missing, or the total raw size exceeds `maxBatchBytes`, the whole call errors.
- Clients with a large skill SHOULD split it across several calls.

### 5.4 `notifications/skills/list_changed`

Server → client, no required params. It is sent when a skill is added or removed, or when any `Skill` field (including `digest`) changes. Clients SHOULD re-run `skills/list` and drop cached content whose digest changed. Servers MUST NOT send it unless `listChanged` is `true` and the client declared the extension.

## 6. Errors

| Condition | Code | `data` |
|---|---|---|
| Extension not negotiated or method unsupported | `-32601` | none |
| Malformed params, bad path, bad cursor | `-32602` | `{ "reason": "invalid_path" \| "invalid_cursor" \| … }` |
| Unknown skill, unknown file, or directory URI | `-32002` | `{ "uri": "…" }` or `{ "name": "…" }` |
| Batch exceeds `maxBatchBytes` or too many paths | `-32602` | `{ "reason": "limit_exceeded", "limit": "maxBatchBytes", "max": 8388608 }` |

## 7. Server obligations

- Every served skill MUST satisfy §4 and §8, or MUST be omitted from listings.
- `skills/list`, `skills/get`, and `resources/read` MUST be consistent. A path in `files` MUST be readable, and a readable `skill://` path MUST appear in `files`.
- Digests MUST be accurate.

## 8. Protocol-fixed limits (ceilings)

| Item | Ceiling |
|---|---|
| Skills per server | 1000 |
| `skills/list` page size | 100 |
| `name` | 64 chars, charset per §4 |
| `description` | 1024 code points |
| `compatibility` | 500 chars |
| `title` | 128 code points |
| `version` | 64 chars |
| `license` | 256 chars |
| `allowedTools` | 64 entries × 128 chars |
| `metadata` | 32 keys, key ≤ 64, value ≤ 1024 |
| Files per skill | 256 |
| Path length / depth | 512 UTF-8 bytes / 8 segments |
| URI length | 2048 bytes |
| `SKILL.md` size | 262,144 bytes (256 KiB) |
| Any single file | 10,485,760 bytes (10 MiB) |
| Total skill size | 67,108,864 bytes (64 MiB) |
| `skills/read` paths per call | 256 |
| `skills/read` raw bytes per call | 16,777,216 bytes (16 MiB) |

Servers may declare lower values in `limits` but never higher.

## 9. Security considerations

- **Untrusted content.** Skill text can contain prompt injection. Clients SHOULD show provenance (server name) and treat remote skills at the trust level of the server.
- **No automatic execution.** Clients MUST NOT run `scripts/` from a skill without the same consent and sandboxing they apply to any code from that server.
- **`allowedTools` is a hint, not a grant.** Clients MUST NOT bypass their own permission policy because a skill requests tools.
- **Path safety.** When materializing to disk, clients MUST re-validate every `path` against §3, MUST reject entries that would escape the target directory, and MUST NOT create symlinks.
- **Integrity.** Clients SHOULD verify each file's `digest` after download and the `digest` of the skill after materialization. Digests detect corruption and drift but don't authenticate the server.
- **Name collisions.** Two servers may expose the same skill `name`. Clients MUST namespace by server (for example `{server}:{name}`) and MUST NOT silently let one server shadow another.
- **Resource exhaustion.** Clients SHOULD enforce the ceilings in §8 on received data even if a server's declared limits are higher or absent.

## 10. Client behavior notes

- Cache by `Skill.digest`. Refetch `SKILL.md` and other files only on a digest change.
- When materializing, write to `{root}/{name}/{path}` and apply the `executable` bit.
- A client unaware of this extension can still work by using the resource template and reading `skill://{name}/SKILL.md` directly, but it won't get typed metadata, digests, or change notifications.

## 11. Open questions

- Whether `title` and server-computed `digest` belong in the extension, or should be carried in `_meta` until the Agent Skills format defines equivalents.
- Whether `skills/read` should be mandatory instead of optional, since per-file `resources/read` is chatty for skills with many references.
- Whether to define namespaced skill names (for example `org/name`) in a later revision. That would be a breaking change to the §4 name rule and so would need a new extension identifier.

# `io.modelcontextprotocol/skills`: Agent Skills for MCP

*Status: design proposal (my own draft, not an published MCP specification). The key words MUST, SHOULD, and MAY are used as in RFC 2119.*

## 1. Overview

An [Agent Skill](https://agentskills.io) is a directory containing a `SKILL.md` (YAML frontmatter plus Markdown instructions) and optional supporting files (`scripts/`, `references/`, `assets/`). This extension lets a server publish skills, and lets a client discover and fetch them, while preserving the progressive-disclosure model:

| Level | Content | Obtained via |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Catalog | `name` + `description` (plus other frontmatter) | `skills/list` |
| 2. Activation | Full `SKILL.md` and the file manifest | `skills/get` |
| 3. Resources | Any other file in the skill | `resources/read` on a `skill://` URI |

Design decisions:

- Two new request methods (`skills/list`, `skills/get`) and one notification. File bytes are served by the existing `resources/read`, so no second file-transfer mechanism is needed. Servers using this extension MUST declare the `resources` capability.
- Skills are identified by `skill://` URIs. A client that doesn't implement the extension can still read a skill file if it knows the URI.
- The server never executes anything. Skills are data; any execution happens client-side under the client's policy.

## 2. Extension identifier and negotiation

The identifier is `io.modelcontextprotocol/skills`. It appears as a key in `capabilities.extensions`.

**Client → server (`initialize` request):**

```json
{
  "capabilities": {
    "extensions": {
      "io.modelcontextprotocol/skills": {}
    }
  }
}
```

The client settings object is currently empty and reserved. Servers MUST ignore unknown keys in it.

**Server → client (`initialize` result):**

```json
{
  "capabilities": {
    "resources": {},
    "extensions": {
      "io.modelcontextprotocol/skills": {
        "listChanged": true,
        "search": false,
        "maxFileBytes": 1048576
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### 2.1 Server settings

| Setting | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listChanged` | boolean | `false` | Server sends `notifications/skills/list_changed` when the set of skills or any skill's `digest` changes. |
| `search` | boolean | `false` | Server honors the `query` parameter of `skills/list`. |
| `maxFileBytes` | integer ≥ 1 | 4194304 | Largest single file (including `SKILL.md`) the server will serve. MAY be lowered below the protocol ceiling, MUST NOT exceed it. Skills with larger files MUST NOT be listed. |

All settings are optional. An empty settings object (`{}`) means the server supports the extension with every setting at its default.

### 2.2 Rules

- The server MUST NOT send `notifications/skills/list_changed` or expect `skills/*` requests unless the client declared the extension.
- If the client did not declare the extension, the server MUST respond to `skills/*` requests with `-32601` (Method not found).
- The identifier carries no version. Additions to this extension are backward-compatible (new optional fields or settings). Breaking changes require a new identifier.

## 3. Resource URIs

```
skill-uri  = "skill://" name "/" path
name       = 1*64( lowercase-alnum / "-" )     ; see §6
path       = segment *( "/" segment )
segment    = 1*pchar                           ; RFC 3986, percent-encoded UTF-8
```

Examples:

```
skill://pdf-processing/SKILL.md
skill://pdf-processing/scripts/extract.py
skill://pdf-processing/references/forms%20guide.md
```

Rules:

- The URI authority is the skill `name`. It MUST equal the `name` in the `SKILL.md` frontmatter.
- `path` is relative to the skill root and uses `/` as the separator. Comparison is case-sensitive, on the percent-decoded UTF-8 bytes.
- A segment MUST NOT be empty, `.` or `..`, and MUST NOT contain a decoded `/`, `\`, or NUL (so `%2F`, `%5C`, `%00` are invalid). URIs MUST NOT have a query or fragment.
- `skill://<name>/SKILL.md` is the canonical entry point of every skill.
- A `resources/read` for a malformed or non-existent skill URI returns `-32002` (Resource not found) with `data: { "uri": "<uri>" }`.
- Servers SHOULD NOT include individual skill files in `resources/list`, to avoid flooding it. They MAY do so, for example for `SKILL.md` only.

## 4. Data types

### 4.1 `Skill`

| Field | Type | Req. | In list | In get | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ | Unique within the server. Same as frontmatter `name`. Grammar and length in §6. |
| `description` | string | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ | What the skill does and when to use it. Same as frontmatter `description`. 1–1024 chars. |
| `uri` | string | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ | `skill://<name>/SKILL.md`. |
| `title` | string | | ✔ | ✔ | Human-readable display name for UIs. Not used for activation matching. ≤ 128 chars. |
| `license` | string | | ✔ | ✔ | Frontmatter `license`. ≤ 256 chars. |
| `compatibility` | string | | ✔ | ✔ | Frontmatter `compatibility` (environment requirements). ≤ 500 chars. |
| `metadata` | object<string,string> | | ✔ | ✔ | Frontmatter `metadata`. ≤ 32 entries, key ≤ 64 chars, value ≤ 1024 chars. |
| `allowedTools` | string[] | | ✔ | ✔ | Frontmatter `allowed-tools`, split on whitespace. ≤ 64 items, each ≤ 128 chars. Advisory only (see §8). |
| `digest` | string | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ | Content digest of the whole skill (§4.3). Lets clients cache and detect changes without fetching files. |
| `totalSize` | integer | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ | Sum of all file sizes in bytes. |
| `fileCount` | integer | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ | Number of files, including `SKILL.md`. |
| `updatedAt` | string | | ✔ | ✔ | RFC 3339 timestamp of last modification. |
| `files` | `SkillFile[]` | ✔ in get, forbidden in list | | ✔ | Complete manifest, sorted by `path` (bytewise). |
| `_meta` | object | | ✔ | ✔ | Standard MCP extension point. |

Entries in `skills/list` MUST omit `files`. The frontmatter is authoritative. If an entry's fields disagree with the fetched `SKILL.md`, the client SHOULD trust the file and MAY warn.

### 4.2 `SkillFile`

| Field | Type | Req. | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | ✔ | Relative path, `/`-separated, no leading slash. Decoded form of the URI path. ≤ 256 UTF-8 bytes, ≤ 8 segments. |
| `uri` | string | ✔ | `skill://<name>/<percent-encoded path>`. |
| `size` | integer | ✔ | Size in bytes of the raw (not base64) content. |
| `digest` | string | ✔ | `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex chars of the raw bytes. |
| `mimeType` | string | | Media type. Text files SHOULD be served as `text`, others as `blob`, in `resources/read`. |
| `executable` | boolean | | Hint that the file was marked executable at the source. Default `false`. Never an instruction to execute (§8). |

`files` MUST contain an entry with `path: "SKILL.md"`. No two entries may have the same path.

### 4.3 Digest computation

- File digest: `"sha256:" + hex(SHA-256(raw file bytes))`.
- Skill digest: build a UTF-8 string by taking each file sorted bytewise by `path` and emitting `<64-hex-file-sha256> <path>\n`. Then `"sha256:" + hex(SHA-256(string))`.

The skill digest therefore changes if and only if a file's content, path, or the file set changes. Clients SHOULD verify file digests after `resources/read` and discard mismatching content.

## 5. Methods

### 5.1 `skills/list`

Lists skill summaries, with standard MCP cursor pagination.

**Params**

| Field | Type | Req. | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cursor` | string | | Opaque cursor from a previous `nextCursor`. |
| `query` | string | | Free-text filter, ≤ 256 chars. Only valid if the server set `search: true`; otherwise the server MUST respond `-32602`. Matching semantics are server-defined (it SHOULD consider `name`, `title`, `description`). |
| `_meta` | object | | Standard. |

**Result**

| Field | Type | Req. | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skills` | `Skill[]` | ✔ | Entries without `files`. At most 100 per page. |
| `nextCursor` | string | | Present iff more pages exist. |
| `_meta` | object | | Standard. |


### 5.2 `skills/get`

```json
       "digest":"sha256:fcde2b2e…","mimeType":"text/x-python","executable":true}
    ]
  },
  "skillMd":{"uri":"skill://pdf-processing/SKILL.md","mimeType":"text/markdown",
             "text":"---\nname: pdf-processing\ndescription: …\n---\n# PDF Processing\n…"}
}}
```

Unknown name: error `-32002` with `data: { "uri": "skill://<name>/SKILL.md" }`. A malformed name: `-32602`.

### 5.3 Reading supporting files: `resources/read`

Standard MCP method with the file's `skill://` URI.

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":4,"method":"resources/read",
 "params":{"uri":"skill://pdf-processing/scripts/extract.py"}}
```
```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":4,"result":{"contents":[{
  "uri":"skill://pdf-processing/scripts/extract.py",
  "mimeType":"text/x-python",
  "text":"import sys\n…",
  "_meta":{"io.modelcontextprotocol/skills":{"digest":"sha256:fcde2b2e…"}}
}]}}
```

Binary files use `blob` (base64) instead of `text`. The result MUST contain exactly one content item. Servers SHOULD include the file digest in `_meta` under the extension key, as shown. A request for a file larger than `maxFileBytes` fails with `-32002`.

### 5.4 `notifications/skills/list_changed`

Sent server → client, with no required params (`_meta` optional), only when `listChanged: true`. It signals that skills were added or removed, or that any skill's `digest` changed. Clients SHOULD re-run `skills/list` and invalidate cached content for skills whose `digest` changed.

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"notifications/skills/list_changed"}
```

If the server also supports `resources.subscribe`, clients MAY subscribe to individual file URIs through the standard `resources/subscribe`. That is independent of this extension.

## 6. Fixed limits

These are protocol-level constants. Servers MUST NOT exceed them and clients MAY reject anything that does.

| Item | Limit |
|---|---|
| `name` | 1–64 chars, regex `^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$` (no leading, trailing, or consecutive hyphens) |
| `description` | 1–1024 chars |
| `title` | ≤ 128 chars |
| `license` | ≤ 256 chars |
| `compatibility` | ≤ 500 chars |
| `metadata` | ≤ 32 entries, key ≤ 64 chars, value ≤ 1024 chars |
| `allowedTools` | ≤ 64 items, each ≤ 128 chars |
| `skills/list` page size | ≤ 100 entries |
| `query` | ≤ 256 chars |
| Path length | ≤ 256 UTF-8 bytes, ≤ 8 segments |
| Files per skill | ≤ 256 |
| `SKILL.md` size | ≤ 262144 bytes (256 KiB) |
| Any other file | ≤ 4194304 bytes (4 MiB); lowered by `maxFileBytes` if set |
| Total skill size | ≤ 16777216 bytes (16 MiB) |
| Skill URI | ≤ 1024 bytes |

Authors are still encouraged to follow the Agent Skills guidance of keeping `SKILL.md` under about 500 lines.

## 7. Errors

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `-32601` | `skills/*` called but the extension wasn't negotiated |
| `-32602` | Bad params: malformed name, invalid cursor, `query` without `search`, unknown or malformed fields |
| `-32002` | Skill or file not found, or file exceeds the size limit. `data.uri` carries the URI. |
| `-32603` | Server-side failure (for example the backing store is unavailable) |

## 8. Security considerations

1. **Skill content is untrusted input.** `SKILL.md` text is instructions for the model, so a malicious or compromised server can attempt prompt injection. Clients SHOULD attribute each skill to its server, SHOULD let users review or enable skills per server, and SHOULD NOT activate skills from a server automatically without a trust decision.
2. **No implicit execution.** `executable: true` and scripts in `scripts/` are never a request to run code. Clients that run skill scripts MUST do so under their own sandbox and approval policy, as they would for any model-initiated action.
3. **`allowedTools` is advisory.** It MUST NOT grant permissions the user or client policy has not already granted. Clients MAY use it to narrow, never widen, tool access.
4. **Path safety.** Clients that materialize skills on disk MUST validate every `path` against §3 (no `..`, absolute paths, backslashes, or symlink escapes) and MUST write only inside a directory dedicated to that skill.
5. **Integrity.** Clients SHOULD verify file and skill digests. Digests protect against truncated or inconsistent transfers and cache staleness, not against a malicious server.
6. **Resource exhaustion.** The limits in §6 bound memory and bandwidth. Clients SHOULD fetch supporting files lazily rather than prefetching whole skills.
7. **Name collisions.** Names are unique only per server. Clients combining several servers MUST namespace skills by server (for example `server-id:name`) and MUST NOT let one server's skill shadow another's.

## 9. Client behavior summary

1. Negotiate the extension. Call `skills/list` (following `nextCursor`) and put `name` and `description` into the model's catalog.
2. On activation, call `skills/get`, load `skillMd.text` into context, and keep `files` as the available-resources index.
3. When the instructions reference a supporting file, call `resources/read` for its `uri`. Verify the digest.
4. On `notifications/skills/list_changed`, or on reconnect, re-list and compare `digest` values against the cache.

# Extension: `io.modelcontextprotocol/skills`

**Status:** Draft proposal
**Extension version:** `2026-11-19`
**Keywords:** MUST, SHOULD, MAY are used as in RFC 2119.

## 1. Overview

Agent Skills are folders containing a `SKILL.md` (YAML frontmatter plus Markdown instructions) and optional supporting files such as `scripts/`, `references/`, and `assets/`. This extension lets an MCP server publish skills to clients.

The design has three parts:

1. **Discovery.** Two new methods, `skills/list` and `skills/get`, return structured metadata. This supports progressive disclosure: a client can load only `name` and `description` for every skill, and fetch the rest on activation.
2. **Content transfer.** File bytes move through the existing `resources/read` method, using a defined `skill://` URI scheme. No new transfer mechanism is introduced.
3. **Change notification.** One notification, `notifications/skills/list_changed`, signals catalog changes.

Servers that use this extension MUST also declare the standard `resources` capability.

## 2. Capability negotiation

The extension is negotiated through the `extensions` map in `capabilities`, keyed by the extension identifier.

### 2.1 Server declaration

```json

  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "protocolVersion": "2025-11-25",
    "serverInfo": { "name": "acme-skills", "version": "3.1.0" },
    "capabilities": {
      "resources": {},
      "extensions": {
        "io.modelcontextprotocol/skills": {
          "version": "2026-11-19",
          "listChanged": true,
          "directoryRead": true,
          "limits": {
            "maxSkills": 200,
            "maxFilesPerSkill": 64,
            "maxFileBytes": 1048576,
            "maxSkillBytes": 8388608
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | string | yes | n/a | Extension revision the server implements. |
| `listChanged` | boolean | no | `false` | Server emits `notifications/skills/list_changed`. |
| `directoryRead` | boolean | no | `false` | Server supports `resources/read` on directory URIs (§4.3). |
| `limits` | object | no | ceilings in §8 | Server-specific limits. Each value MUST be ≤ the corresponding ceiling in §8. |
| `limits.maxSkills` | integer ≥ 1 | no | 1000 | Maximum number of skills offered. |
| `limits.maxFilesPerSkill` | integer ≥ 1 | no | 256 | Maximum files in any one skill. |
| `limits.maxFileBytes` | integer ≥ 1 | no | 5 242 880 | Maximum size of any one file (raw bytes). |
| `limits.maxSkillBytes` | integer ≥ 1 | no | 26 214 400 | Maximum total size of all files in a skill. |

### 2.3 Negotiation rules

- The extension is **active** only if both sides declare it, and the server also declares `resources`.
- If it is not active, the server MUST respond to `skills/*` requests with `-32601` (Method not found) and MUST NOT send `notifications/skills/list_changed`.
- If the `version` values differ, each side SHOULD behave according to the lower (earlier) one. A side that cannot do so SHOULD treat the extension as inactive.
- A server MAY additionally expose skill files via `resources/list` so that hosts without this extension can still see them as ordinary resources. `skills/list` remains authoritative.

### 3.3 `notifications/skills/list_changed`

If the server also declares `resources.subscribe`, it MAY send `notifications/resources/updated` for individual skill file URIs.

## 4. Resource URIs and reading

Content is transferred with the standard `resources/read` method.

### 4.1 URI grammar

```
skill-uri  = "skill://" name [ "/" [ path ] ]
name       = 1*64( lower / digit / "-" )     ; see §5.1
path       = segment *( "/" segment )
segment    = 1*( pchar )                      ; RFC 3986 pchar, percent-encoded UTF-8
```

- `skill://{name}/SKILL.md` identifies the required entry file.
- `skill://{name}/{path}` identifies any file. `path` is POSIX-style, relative to the skill root, case-sensitive, and MUST NOT contain `.` or `..` segments, empty segments, backslashes, or a leading `/`.
- `skill://{name}/` (trailing slash, empty path) identifies the whole skill directory (§4.3).
- URIs MUST NOT contain a query or fragment, and MUST be ≤ 2048 bytes.

### 4.2 Reading a single file

Standard `resources/read` with the file URI. The result's `contents` contains exactly one item. Text files use `text`. Binary files use base64 `blob`. Each item has `uri` and `mimeType`.

```json
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 4, "method": "resources/read",
  "params": { "uri": "skill://pdf-processing/SKILL.md" } }
```

```json
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 4, "result": { "contents": [
  { "uri": "skill://pdf-processing/SKILL.md", "mimeType": "text/markdown",
    "text": "---\nname: pdf-processing\ndescription: Extract text and tables from PDF files...\n---\n\n# PDF Processing\n\nSee [forms](references/FORMS.md)...\n" }
] } }
```

**Relative links.** Relative references inside `SKILL.md` (e.g. `references/FORMS.md`, `scripts/extract.py`) MUST be resolved against the base URI `skill://{name}/SKILL.md` per RFC 3986. Clients and models therefore need no special path logic.

### 4.3 Reading a directory (optional)

If the server declared `directoryRead: true`, reading `skill://{name}/` returns every file of the skill in one `contents` array. Each item uses its file URI. `SKILL.md` MUST come first, and the remaining items follow in bytewise path order. The total raw size is bounded by `maxSkillBytes` and the client's `maxReadBytes`. If either would be exceeded, the server MUST return error `-32050` (§7), and the client falls back to per-file reads.

If `directoryRead` is false or absent, the server MUST return `-32002` (resource not found) for directory URIs.

### 4.4 Encoding rules

- `SKILL.md` MUST be UTF-8 and returned as `text` with `mimeType` `text/markdown`.
- For other files, the server SHOULD use `text` when the file is valid UTF-8 and has a text media type, and `blob` otherwise. Clients MUST honor whichever field is present.
- Digests are computed over the **raw bytes**, not the base64 form.

### 5.1 Field reference: `Skill`

| Field | Type | Req. | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | 1–64 chars; `^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$`; unique per server | Programmatic identifier. MUST equal the `name` in SKILL.md frontmatter and the `{name}` in the URI. |
| `title` | string | no | 1–128 chars | Human-friendly display name. Not part of SKILL.md frontmatter. |
| `description` | string | yes | 1–1024 chars | What the skill does and when to use it. MUST equal the frontmatter `description`. |
| `uri` | string | yes | MUST be `skill://{name}/SKILL.md` | Location of the entry file. |
| `license` | string | no | ≤ 256 chars | From frontmatter `license`. |
| `compatibility` | string | no | ≤ 500 chars | From frontmatter `compatibility` (environment requirements). |
| `allowedTools` | string[] | no | ≤ 64 items, each 1–128 chars | From frontmatter `allowed-tools` (space-delimited there, split into an array here). **Advisory only** (§9). |
| `metadata` | object | no | ≤ 32 keys; key ≤ 64 chars; value ≤ 512 chars; string values only | From frontmatter `metadata`. |
| `version` | string | no | ≤ 64 chars | Publisher-assigned version label. Opaque to the protocol. |
| `digest` | string | yes | `sha256:` + 64 lowercase hex | Content digest of the whole skill (§5.3). |
| `fileCount` | integer | yes | 1 ≤ n ≤ `maxFilesPerSkill` | Number of files, including `SKILL.md`. |
| `size` | integer | yes | ≥ 1, ≤ `maxSkillBytes` | Sum of raw file sizes in bytes. |
| `lastModified` | string | no | RFC 3339 UTC timestamp | Most recent modification of any file. |
| `files` | `SkillFile[]` | `skills/get` only | length = `fileCount` | Complete file manifest, sorted bytewise by `path`. MUST be omitted from `skills/list`. |
| `_meta` | object | no | n/a | Reserved for extension-specific or vendor metadata. |

### 5.2 Field reference: `SkillFile`

| Field | Type | Req. | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | ≤ 256 UTF-8 bytes; ≤ 8 segments; see §4.1 | Path relative to the skill root, using `/`. |
| `uri` | string | yes | `skill://{name}/{percent-encoded path}` | URI for `resources/read`. |
| `mimeType` | string | no | RFC 6838 media type | Media type. SHOULD be present. |
| `size` | integer | yes | 0 ≤ n ≤ `maxFileBytes` | Raw size in bytes. |
| `digest` | string | yes | `sha256:` + 64 lowercase hex | SHA-256 of the raw bytes. |
| `role` | enum | no | `instructions`, `script`, `reference`, `asset`, `other` | Hint derived from layout. `SKILL.md` is `instructions`, `scripts/**` is `script`, `references/**` is `reference`, `assets/**` is `asset`, and anything else is `other`. |
| `_meta` | object | no | n/a | Reserved. |

### 5.3 Skill digest computation

1. Sort the file entries by `path` (bytewise on UTF-8).
2. For each file, form the line `"{path}\0{lowercase-hex-sha256-of-bytes}\n"`.
3. Concatenate the lines, take the SHA-256, and format as `sha256:{hex}`.

Because the digest depends only on paths and content, it is stable across servers, and clients can use it as a cache key.

### 5.4 Validity

- A skill without a `SKILL.md` at its root is invalid, and the server MUST NOT list it.
- Frontmatter-derived fields MUST match `SKILL.md`. A client MAY verify this after reading and SHOULD treat `SKILL.md` as authoritative on mismatch.
- Skill names are flat and unique within one server. Clients aggregating several servers MUST namespace skills by server themselves to resolve collisions.

## 6. Typical flow

1. `initialize`: both sides negotiate the extension.
2. `skills/list` (paginated): the client loads `name` and `description` for each skill into its catalog. This is the cheap first tier.
3. On activation: `resources/read skill://{name}/SKILL.md`. The client may check `digest` against its cache first.
4. As the instructions reference other files, the client reads `references/*` and `assets/*` lazily by URI. Scripts are fetched only when needed.
5. To prefetch or materialize a skill locally: `skills/get` for the manifest, then per-file reads or one directory read.
6. On `notifications/skills/list_changed`: re-list and diff by `digest`.

## 7. Errors

Standard JSON-RPC and MCP codes are used wherever they fit.

| Code | Name | When |
|---|---|---|
| `-32601` | Method not found | `skills/*` called while the extension is inactive. |
| `-32602` | Invalid params | Malformed `name`, invalid cursor, or a malformed URI. |
| `-32002` | Resource not found | Unknown skill or file, or a directory read when `directoryRead` is false. `data: { "name": "...", "uri": "..." }` |
| `-32050` | Skill limit exceeded | A read would exceed `maxFileBytes`, `maxSkillBytes`, or the client's `maxReadBytes`. |

For `-32050`, `data` carries `{ "limit": "maxFileBytes" | "maxSkillBytes" | "maxReadBytes", "max": <int>, "actual": <int> }`.

```json
  "error": { "code": -32050, "message": "Skill limit exceeded",
             "data": { "limit": "maxReadBytes", "max": 4194304, "actual": 7340032 } } }
```

| URI length | ≤ 2048 bytes |
| `SKILL.md` size | ≤ 262 144 bytes (256 KiB) |
| Any other file | ≤ 5 242 880 bytes (5 MiB) raw |
| Total skill size | ≤ 26 214 400 bytes (25 MiB) raw |
| Digest format | `sha256:` + 64 lowercase hex characters |

Servers SHOULD keep the `SKILL.md` body under about 500 lines and push detail into `references/`, so that activation stays cheap.

## 9. Security considerations

- **Untrusted content.** Skill instructions and scripts come from the server and may contain prompt injection or malicious code. Clients MUST NOT execute fetched scripts without applying their normal tool-execution and user-consent policies. Trust in a skill SHOULD NOT exceed trust in its server.
- **`allowedTools` is advisory.** Clients MUST NOT treat it as a grant of permission. It can only narrow what the client already allows, never widen it.
- **Path safety.** When materializing a skill to disk, clients MUST reject any `path` that is absolute, contains `..`, `.`, empty, or backslash segments, or resolves outside the skill root after normalization. Clients MUST NOT follow or create symlinks from skill content.
- **Integrity.** Clients SHOULD verify each file's `digest` after reading, and the skill `digest` after assembling all files. A mismatch means the skill changed mid-read, so re-list and retry.
- **Shadowing.** A remote skill MUST NOT silently override a local or user-installed skill of the same name. Clients SHOULD namespace remote skills and surface their origin to the user.
- **Resource exhaustion.** Clients SHOULD enforce their own byte and count caps regardless of what the server declares.
- **Transport and authorization.** The standard MCP authorization and transport protections apply. Servers SHOULD scope the skill catalog to the authenticated principal.

## 10. Backward compatibility and extensibility

- Clients and servers that don't declare the extension are unaffected. Skill files remain ordinary `skill://` resources if a server chooses to list them.
- Unknown fields in `Skill`, `SkillFile`, capability objects, and results MUST be ignored by receivers.
- Future revisions may add search/filter params to `skills/list`, archive delivery, and per-skill subscriptions. These would be signaled by new capability fields and a new `version`.

# MCP Extension: Agent Skills (`io.modelcontextprotocol/skills`)

**Status:** Draft design proposal (not an existing part of the MCP specification)
**Extension identifier:** `io.modelcontextprotocol/skills`
**Depends on:** MCP base protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0, capability negotiation, pagination), the `resources` capability, and the `capabilities.extensions` framework

The key words MUST, MUST NOT, SHOULD, SHOULD NOT and MAY are used as in RFC 2119.

---

## 1. Overview

An **Agent Skill** is a directory containing a `SKILL.md` file (YAML frontmatter plus Markdown instructions) and optional supporting files, typically under `scripts/`, `references/` and `assets/`.

This extension lets a server publish skills to a client with **progressive disclosure**:

| Level | Content | Retrieved via |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `name`, `description` and other frontmatter-derived fields | `skills/list` |
| 2 | Full `SKILL.md` | `resources/read` on the skill's `uri` |
| 3 | Supporting files (and an optional zip bundle) | `skills/get` for the manifest, then `resources/read` |

Discovery is new (two methods and one notification). Content delivery reuses MCP resources through a `skill://` URI scheme.

---

## 2. Capability Negotiation

### 2.1 Client declaration

A client that supports the extension includes it in `initialize`:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "initialize",
  "params": {
    "protocolVersion": "2025-11-25",
    "capabilities": {
      "extensions": {
        "io.modelcontextprotocol/skills": {}
      }
    },
    "clientInfo": { "name": "example-client", "version": "1.0.0" }
  }
}
```

The client defines no settings. An empty object means "supported". Unknown settings MUST be ignored.

### 2.2 Server declaration

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "protocolVersion": "2025-11-25",
    "capabilities": {
      "resources": {},
      "extensions": {
        "io.modelcontextprotocol/skills": {
          "listChanged": true,
          "bundles": true
        }
      }
    },
    "serverInfo": { "name": "example-server", "version": "2.3.0" }
  }
}
```

### 2.3 Server settings

| Setting | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listChanged` | boolean | `false` | Server sends `notifications/skills/list_changed` when the set of skills, or any skill's content, changes. |
| `bundles` | boolean | `false` | Server can serve each skill as a single zip archive (§6.3). When `true`, `skills/get` results MAY include `bundle`. |

Rules:

- A server declaring this extension MUST also declare the `resources` capability, because file content is served via `resources/read`.
- The methods and notification in this document are available only if **both** parties declared the extension. Otherwise the receiver MUST answer requests with `-32601` (Method not found), and the server MUST NOT send notifications.
- Unknown settings MUST be ignored.
- The limits in §8 are fixed by the protocol and are not negotiable.

---

## 3. Skill Layout and Resource URIs

### 3.1 Skill directory

```
<name>/
├── SKILL.md          (required)
├── scripts/          (optional)
├── references/       (optional)
└── assets/           (optional)
```

`SKILL.md` MUST begin with YAML frontmatter containing at least `name` and `description`, per the Agent Skills format. The frontmatter `name` MUST equal the skill's `name` on the wire.

### 3.2 URI scheme

```
skill://<name>/<path>
```

| URI | Refers to |
|---|---|
| `skill://pdf-processing/` | Skill root. Read returns the zip bundle if `bundles` is enabled (§6.3). |
| `skill://pdf-processing/SKILL.md` | The skill's instructions. This is the entry's `uri`. |
| `skill://pdf-processing/scripts/extract.py` | A supporting file. |

Rules:

- The authority is the skill `name` and is therefore lowercase.
- `<path>` is relative to the skill root, uses `/` separators and is percent-encoded per RFC 3986. The `path` fields in JSON are **unencoded** UTF-8 (NFC).
- A path MUST NOT be empty, start with `/`, contain `\`, contain control characters, or contain `.` or `..` segments. Paths are case-sensitive.
- Relative references inside `SKILL.md` (for example `references/REFERENCE.md`) are resolved per RFC 3986 against the `SKILL.md` URI. They therefore map onto `skill://<name>/references/REFERENCE.md`.
- URIs are scoped to the server connection. A client connected to several servers MUST namespace skills itself (for example by server ID plus name).

### 3.3 Resource templates

A server SHOULD advertise the following template via `resources/templates/list`:

```json
{
  "uriTemplate": "skill://{name}/{+path}",
  "name": "skill-file",
  "description": "A file within an Agent Skill"
}
```

A server SHOULD NOT include individual skill files in `resources/list`, to avoid flooding it. It MAY do so.

---

## 4. Data Types

### 4.1 `SkillEntry`

Returned by `skills/list`. Mirrors the frontmatter, plus integrity and size information.

| Field | Type | Req. | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Skill identifier. Matches `^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$`, 1–64 chars. Unique within the server. |
| `description` | string | yes | What the skill does and when to use it. 1–1024 chars. Copied from frontmatter. |
| `uri` | string | yes | URI of the skill's `SKILL.md` (`skill://<name>/SKILL.md`). |
| `digest` | string | yes | Content digest of the whole skill (§4.4). Changes iff any file changes. |
| `license` | string | no | From frontmatter `license`. Max 512 chars. |
| `compatibility` | string | no | From frontmatter `compatibility`, describing environment requirements. 1–500 chars. |
| `allowedTools` | string[] | no | From frontmatter `allowed-tools`, split on whitespace. Max 64 items of max 128 chars. **Advisory only** (§9). |
| `metadata` | object (string→string) | no | From frontmatter `metadata`. Max 32 keys. Keys max 64 chars, values max 256 chars. |
| `version` | string | no | Author-assigned label, taken from `metadata.version` if present. Max 64 chars. Opaque. Use `digest` to detect changes. |
| `totalSize` | integer | no | Sum of all file sizes in bytes. |
| `updatedAt` | string | no | RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of last modification. |
| `_meta` | object | no | Reserved for implementation-specific data, per MCP convention. |

A server MUST keep these fields consistent with the frontmatter of the `SKILL.md` it serves. `SKILL.md` is authoritative if they disagree, and a client MAY verify after reading it.

### 4.2 `SkillDetail`

Returned by `skills/get`. It is a `SkillEntry` plus:

| Field | Type | Req. | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `files` | `SkillFile[]` | yes | Manifest of every file in the skill, including `SKILL.md`, sorted by `path` (bytewise on UTF-8). |
| `bundle` | `SkillBundle` | no | Present only if the server declared `bundles: true`. |

### 4.3 `SkillFile` and `SkillBundle`

**`SkillFile`**

| Field | Type | Req. | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path relative to the skill root, for example `scripts/extract.py`. Unencoded. |
| `uri` | string | yes | Resource URI for `resources/read`. |
| `size` | integer | yes | Size in bytes. |
| `digest` | string | yes | `sha256:<64 lowercase hex>` of the raw file bytes. |
| `mimeType` | string | no | MIME type. `SKILL.md` SHOULD be `text/markdown`. |

**`SkillBundle`**

| Field | Type | Req. | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uri` | string | yes | The skill root URI (`skill://<name>/`). |
| `mimeType` | string | yes | Always `application/zip`. |
| `size` | integer | yes | Archive size in bytes. |
| `digest` | string | yes | `sha256:<hex>` of the archive bytes. |

### 4.4 Skill digest

Build a manifest with one line per file, sorted bytewise by `path`:

```
<64-hex-sha256-of-file>␠␠<path>\n
```

This is `sha256sum` format with LF terminators. The skill `digest` is `"sha256:"` plus the lowercase hex SHA-256 of that manifest (UTF-8).

---

## 5. Methods

### 5.1 `skills/list`

Lists skills (progressive-disclosure level 1). Paginated using the standard MCP cursor mechanism.

**Request params**

| Field | Type | Req. | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cursor` | string | no | Opaque cursor from a previous `nextCursor`. |
| `_meta` | object | no | Standard request metadata. |

**Result**

| Field | Type | Req. | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skills` | `SkillEntry[]` | yes | At most 100 entries, sorted by `name` ascending (bytewise). |
| `nextCursor` | string | no | Present if more pages exist. |

```json
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 2, "method": "skills/list", "params": {} }
```

**Result**

## 6. Content Retrieval

### 6.1 Reading files

Files are read with the standard `resources/read`:

```json
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 4, "method": "resources/read",
  "params": { "uri": "skill://pdf-processing/SKILL.md" } }
```

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 4,
  "result": {
    "contents": [
      {
        "uri": "skill://pdf-processing/SKILL.md",
        "mimeType": "text/markdown",
        "text": "---\nname: pdf-processing\ndescription: ...\n---\n\n# PDF Processing\n..."
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### 6.2 Text and binary

Files that are valid UTF-8 are returned in `text`. All other files are returned base64-encoded in `blob`. The server MUST return exactly one `contents` item per file URI. The returned bytes MUST hash to the `digest` in the manifest, and clients SHOULD verify this.

### 6.3 Bundles

If `bundles` is `true`, `resources/read` on the skill root URI returns the archive:

```json
{
  "contents": [{
    "uri": "skill://pdf-processing/",
    "mimeType": "application/zip",
    "blob": "<base64>"
  }]
}
```

Archive requirements:

- The archive MUST contain exactly the files listed in `files`, with paths relative to the skill root and no wrapping directory.
- It MUST NOT contain symlinks, absolute paths, `..` segments or directory-only entries that are not implied by file paths.
- It MUST be at most 32 MiB.

If `bundles` is not enabled, reading the root URI is an error (§7).

---

## 7. Notifications and Errors

### 7.1 `notifications/skills/list_changed`

Server → client. Sent only if `listChanged` is `true`. It has no required params (`_meta` is permitted). On receipt the client SHOULD re-run `skills/list` and compare `digest` values to find changed skills, and it SHOULD discard cached files of changed skills.

```json
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "notifications/skills/list_changed" }
```

If the server also declares `resources.subscribe`, clients MAY use `resources/subscribe` on individual skill file URIs for finer-grained `notifications/resources/updated`.

### 7.2 Errors

| Condition | Code | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Unknown skill name in `skills/get` | `-32602` | `data: {"reason": "skill_not_found", "name": "..."}` |
| Malformed or expired `cursor` | `-32602` | `data: {"reason": "invalid_cursor"}` |
| Missing skill file, or root read when `bundles` is off, in `resources/read` | `-32002` | Standard MCP resource-not-found. Include `data.uri`. |
| Extension not negotiated | `-32601` | Method not found. |
| Server failure | `-32603` | Internal error. |

---

## 8. Fixed Limits

Servers MUST NOT exceed these limits, and clients MAY reject skills that do.

| Item | Limit |
|---|---|
| `name` length | 1–64 characters, pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$` |
| `description` length | 1–1024 characters |
| `compatibility` length | 1–500 characters |
| `license` length | ≤ 512 characters |
| `version` length | ≤ 64 characters |
| `allowedTools` | ≤ 64 items, each ≤ 128 characters |
| `metadata` | ≤ 32 keys, key ≤ 64 characters, value ≤ 256 characters |
| `skills/list` page size | ≤ 100 entries |
| `SKILL.md` size | ≤ 256 KiB (262,144 bytes) |
| Files per skill | ≤ 256 |
| Single file size | ≤ 8 MiB (8,388,608 bytes) |
| Total skill size | ≤ 32 MiB (33,554,432 bytes) |
| Path length | ≤ 255 bytes (UTF-8) |
| Path depth | ≤ 8 segments |
| Digest format | `sha256:` + 64 lowercase hex characters |
| Bundle format | Zip only (`application/zip`) |

---

## 9. Security Considerations

- **Untrusted content.** Skills contain instructions and possibly executable scripts. Clients MUST treat them like untrusted input from the server. They MUST NOT execute bundled scripts without the same user consent or sandboxing they apply to other code execution.
- **Prompt injection.** `description` and `SKILL.md` text can steer the model. Clients SHOULD show users which servers contribute skills and SHOULD let users disable individual skills.
- **`allowedTools` is not a grant.** It expresses what the author expects the skill to use. Clients MUST NOT auto-approve tools because a skill lists them.
- **Path safety.** Clients MUST reject any file path or archive entry that is absolute, contains `..`, or would resolve outside the skill's directory when written to disk. They MUST NOT follow symlinks from archives.
- **Integrity.** Clients SHOULD verify file and bundle digests. Digests detect corruption and drift. They are not an authenticity guarantee, since the server produces them.
- **Name collisions.** Two servers may expose the same `name`. Clients MUST NOT let one server's skill silently shadow another's.
- **Resource exhaustion.** Clients SHOULD enforce the §8 limits before downloading, using `size` and `totalSize`.

---

## 10. Typical Flow

```
Client                                   Server
  |-- initialize (extensions: skills) -->|
  |<-- result (listChanged, bundles) ----|
  |-- notifications/initialized -------->|
  |-- skills/list ---------------------->|   level 1: name + description
  |<-- skills[], nextCursor -------------|
  |   (model decides "pdf-processing" is relevant)
  |-- resources/read SKILL.md ---------->|   level 2: instructions
  |<-- contents[text] -------------------|
  |-- skills/get {name} ---------------->|   level 3: manifest (if needed)
  |<-- skill{files[], bundle} -----------|
  |-- resources/read scripts/extract.py ->|
  |<-- contents[text] -------------------|
  |<-- notifications/skills/list_changed-|   later: re-list, compare digests
```

---

## 11. Open Design Questions

1. **Server-side filtering.** `skills/list` has no `query` or `names` filter. Servers with hundreds of skills may want one.
2. **Per-skill change notifications.** Only list-level notifications are defined, plus the optional reuse of `resources/subscribe`.
3. **Nested or namespaced skill names** (for example `org/skill`) are not supported. Names are flat so that they fit in a URI authority.
